column1: # A MADE-UP test language "xz" for the font fallback and the input method (translation wave 6):
# Tools/UWCheckLib/Checks/LanguageFontChecks.cs and the editor's UW / Check font fallback
# (Assets/Editor/UWFontFallbackCheck.cs). Its texts are strings of common CJK characters and
# Cyrillic words put together at random - no language's words and no text of the game.
# The font: a file beside the game first (not in the repository - no font is), then fonts a
# system may have installed - Microsoft JhengHei (Windows 11) has the ideographs but no Cyrillic,
# Arial (Windows) the Cyrillic; Noto Sans CJK TC and DejaVu Sans are their like on many Linux systems.
